title: Corporate Gym Discounts in NZ — How to Get a Cheaper Membership Through Work
meta_desc: Discover corporate gym discounts in NZ and save up to 20% on memberships through employee wellness programmes
intro: Many Kiwis are unaware that their workplace can provide significant discounts on gym memberships, with some employers offering up to 20% off standard rates. Companies like NZHL and Southern Cross offer discounted gym memberships as part of their employee wellness programmes. By negotiating a corporate rate, you can enjoy cheaper gym memberships at popular franchises like Les Mills and Anytime Fitness.

sections.heading: How Corporate Gym Discounts Work
sections.body: Corporate gym discounts are available to employees of participating companies, with the employer often covering a portion of the membership cost. This can result in significant savings for employees, with discounts ranging from 10% to 20% off standard rates. For example, a standard monthly membership at Les Mills typically costs around $130, but with a corporate discount, this could be reduced to $104 per month.

sections.heading: Negotiating a Corporate Rate
sections.body: If your employer does not currently offer a corporate gym discount, it's worth negotiating a rate with your HR department. Many gyms are willing to offer discounts to companies with a minimum number of employees, typically around 10-20. You can also suggest partnering with a specific gym, such as Jetts or City Fitness, which may offer more competitive corporate rates.

sections.heading: Example: Les Mills Corporate Membership
sections.body: Les Mills offers corporate memberships at over 40 locations across NZ, with discounts available for employees of participating companies. A standard 12-month membership at Les Mills typically costs around $1,560, but with a corporate discount, this could be reduced to $1,248. You can learn more about Les Mills corporate memberships and pricing on their website or by visiting a local gym.
